Last time iam not attended this time MD told me to attend this time. what i can do whether iam attend the party or not.iam ready to do any thing. what allah will. Question: As-Salamu Alaikum Mufti Saab, My company will arrange the party which contain music,alcohol and food for this month end. party for all company staff. Last time iam not attended this time MD told me to attend this time. what i can do whether iam attend the party or not.iam ready to do any thing. what allah will. Answer ID: 29326 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 155/113/L=1432) It shall not be lawful for you to participate in that party when you know already that music and alcohol etc shall be used therein. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
